# 4 teams. The losers-bracket team wins the grand final: a second, deciding game (bracket reset).
teams 4
stage double_knockout
play 1-4 1
play 2-3 3
expect ready 1-3 2-4               # winners final and losers round 1, in any order
play 2-4 2
play 1-3 1
expect ready 2-3                   # losers final: the loser of the winners final drops in
play 2-3 3
expect ready 1-3                   # grand final
play 1-3 3
expect state s1-GF-2-1 ready
expect running
play 1-3 1
expect finished
expect placements 1:1 2:3 3:2
